- **(a)** `VCS_REMINDER` now says bypassing hooks or signing is allowed only when the user asks, and amending only your own unpushed commit. `rebase -i`, `reset --hard` and amending a published or another author's commit still need the user's approval. - **(d)**
  - `setupNotice(env, cwd)` now counts the project and local settings of the session folder, so a key present in any of them stops the notice.
  - It spawns no process. It looks in `cwd` and in the nearest ancestor that has a `.git` entry, found with `projectSettingsFiles` in `scope.ts`.

- **(f)** A git top-level is trusted only if it is `cwd` or an ancestor and holds a `.git` entry. The refusal message now reads "…not the current directory or an ancestor holding a .git entry". The scope test fixture now creates `repo/.git`.
